name: csv_reconcile_returns
title: CSV Reconcile Returns
prompt: read_file orders.csv and refunds.csv. Compute with run_lua using FILES['orders.csv'] and FILES['refunds.csv'] (there is no global orders table). For every order data row: totals[sku] += qty * unit_price. For every refund row: totals[sku] -= amount. Submit only the SKU with the largest net as 'SKU-XX N.NN'.
